mapper.select: SELECT r.*, g.id as g_id, g.name as g_name, g.icon as g_icon, g.platforms as g_platforms, g.game_types as g_game_types FROM game_record r LEFT JOIN game g ON r.game_id = g.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY r.record_date DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT DATE(record_date) as date, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(play_time) as totalMinutes FROM game_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(record_date) = #{year} AND is_delete = 0 GROUP BY DATE(record_date)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(play_time), 0) as totalMinutes, COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) as gameCount, COUNT(*) as recordCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN record_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN play_time ELSE 0 END), 0) as weekMinutes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(record_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(record_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN play_time ELSE 0 END), 0) as monthMinutes FROM game_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_delete = 0

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.icon, SUM(r.play_time) as totalMinutes, COUNT(*) as playCount FROM game_record r LEFT JOIN game g ON r.game_id = g.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.icon ORDER BY totalMinutes DESC LIMIT #{limit}
